annotations.title: DNS Lookup: A, MX, TXT, NS Records with SPF and DMARC Check

description: Resolve public DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME) and report whether SPF and DMARC records are present, with their policies. DNS queries only; no connection is made to the domain itself. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).
name: dns_lookup
